thread:
Alex: Morning quick pulse — train looks green overall but small churn on the canary. Cherry queue = 5 (3 infra, 2 docs). Planning a short GPU swap for the canary to try a different driver build. Anyone object? :yelling_face:
Maria: No objections. Which node pool are we moving to?
Alex: Moving from gpux-12 to gpux-16 (same region). Expect ~3m interruption for the canary.
Chen: FYI two CRs need rebase before merge: #482 (kv-cache tweak) and #489 (health-check fix). I pinged authors yesterday but still WIP.
Sanjay: I can do the swap at 11:30 PT. Will roll back if we hit regressions. Can someone keep an eye on latency graphs?
Priya: I'll watch the dashboards and keep an eye on 95/99 p95/p99. Tag me if token latency spikes. :eyes:
deploy-bot: Canary deploy starting for train v2026.03.17-canary (id: cny-77a).
Alex: To reduce noise, please only merge cherrypicks after the canary is stable for 10m. If you must push, call it out here with expected risk.
Maria: Quick note — docs cherrypick (PR #501) is tiny, non-prod, can go after canary.
Chen: Also seeing a few OOMs in the model-quant job logs during the canary run:
```
2026-03-17T11:02:14Z model-quant[pid=1234]: allocation failed: cudamalloc returned error 2
2026-03-17T11:02:14Z model-quant: falling back to fp16 path
```
Alex: Good catch. That might explain small latency blips. Sizing mismatch after recent quantization update.
Sanjay: I'll flip to gpux-16 and bump driver to 510.39, then restart the canary. Command: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/canary`
Priya: If we still see OOMs, let's revert the quant change on the canary branch and run a quick checkpoint eval.
Alex: Sounds good. Action list: 1) S swap @11:30 (Sanjay) 2) Priya monitor metrics 3) Chen rebase CRs and hold merges until green 4) Maria holds docs merge until stable.
Maria: acked. ping me if rollback is needed. :thumbsup:
Chen: I'll rebase #482/#489 now, aim to finish in 30m.
Sanjay: Starting swap in ~2m.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy finished (duration 04:12) — status: degraded (see logs).
Alex: Noted degraded — Priya, can you grab p95/p99 trending from the last 15m and post screenshots?
Priya: On it, uploading in 2m.
Alex: Thanks team. We'll reconvene here after the metrics. If the canary doesn't stabilize, we roll back to v2026.03.16-prod.
__notes: Single-thread Slack conversation. Messages are chronological, prefixed by sender. No title field per agents.md.
